other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates group statistics and frequency encodings on the entire training set before splitting it into cross-validation folds. This leaks the feature distributions of the validation sets into the training folds, making the out-of-fold performance estimates overly optimistic.

summary: The agent implements a strong gradient boosting ensemble with optimal weight search and cross-validation, but suffers from data leakage during preprocessing. Specifically, it computes imputation medians, frequency encodings, and group statistics on the entire training set before the CV split, which compromises the integrity of the out-of-fold validation scores. Additionally, it inappropriately peeks at the test set to define the categorical encodings.
